run_locate3d_inference: run inference on a 3D pointcloud with a text caption using the pretrained Locate3D model
load_locate3d_dataset: create a Locate3DDataset from an annotations JSON file with featurized pointclouds enabled
load_pretrained_locate3d_model: load the pretrained facebook/locate-3d model using Locate3D.from_pretrained
downsample_pointcloud: downsample a featurized sensor pointcloud to a target number of points using downsample
access_dataset_sample: access a specific annotated scene sample from the Locate3DDataset by index
